records.rationale: The diff shows `destinationCalendar: eventType.destinationCalendar ? [eventType.destinationCalendar] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [organizerUser.destinationCalendar] : null` — i.e., it can be `null` — followed by `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. With optional chaining, when the organizer/eventType has no destination calendar but collective team members do, those members' destinationCalendars are silently dropped, so no calendar events get created for them. This is a real, verifiable defect introduced by this exact code path.
